routines.name: Attentive idle
routines.action: Breathe, blink, gently move individual tails.

routines.name: Walk
routines.action: Measured fox gait with flowing tails; in-place cycle.

routines.name: Trot
routines.action: Light, curious quick steps; in-place cycle.

routines.name: Hover idle
routines.action: Suspended paws, slow bob, floating tails.

routines.name: Floating travel
routines.action: Lean into gentle drifting travel; in-place cycle.

routines.name: Seated watch
routines.action: Observe calmly, turn ears, blink.

routines.name: Think
routines.action: Hold thoughtful head tilts and bring one existing forepaw to the chin.

routines.name: Read
routines.action: Unroll a scroll, study it, then roll it closed and stow it.

routines.name: Write
routines.action: Unroll a small scroll, make abstract brush strokes, tidy everything away.

routines.name: Insight
routines.action: Ears lift and one small ink-like spark appears, then disappears.

routines.name: Groom
routines.action: Lick a paw and smooth one ear.

routines.name: Stretch
routines.action: Extend forelegs, arch back, spread tails and settle.

routines.name: Tail play
routines.action: Notice and gently bat at one of his own tails.

routines.name: Greeting
routines.action: Small head bow and friendly paw lift.

routines.name: Sleep
routines.action: Curled sleeping posture, soft breathing, three tails visible.

routines.name: Meditate
routines.action: Close eyes and coordinate slow calm tail movements.

routines.name: Samurai practice
routines.action: Wear a simple headband, draw a real steel katana, perform a controlled cut, return to guard, sheathe and bow.
routines.constraints: Real steel blade with restrained highlight, guard and wrapped grip. Consistent sword length and shape.

routines.name: Ninja sneak
routines.action: Tie indigo headband, crouch, tiptoe in place, glance around, relax and remove headband.

routines.name: Spirit magic
routines.action: Shape a vermilion-and-indigo wisp into a tiny fox, then dissolve it.

routines.name: Straw-hat adventurer
routines.action: Don red-banded straw hat and open red vest; grin, tip hat and perform a playful elastic paw punch; remove costume.
routines.constraints: Luffy reference through costume and action, preserving fox identity and exactly three tails. Elastic punch stays in frame.

routines.name: Fishing daydream
routines.action: Cast tiny rod, wait, pull up an autumn leaf, inspect with mild surprise, pack away.

routines.name: Bamboo flute
routines.action: Raise small flute, play with swaying ears and tails, lower and stow it.

routines.name: Tea break
routines.action: Unwrap tiny cup and flask, pour, sip thoughtfully, pack away.

routines.name: Fan dance
routines.action: Open vermilion folding fan, perform restrained two-step flourish, bow and close fan.
